_readme: Your decisions about restaurants that are in the database but no longer in OpenStreetMap.
run_7_loading.py lists the undecided ones in data/review/removed_from_osm.json and applies these on every load.
Key: the restaurant's osm_id (copy it from data/review/removed_from_osm.json).
decision: closed = keep it as PERMANENTLY_CLOSED (its history stays; it no longer counts as open);
delete = remove it from the database (with its reviews and links) and from the graph;
keep   = leave it as it is (OSM deleted it by mistake); it then leaves the review file.
note: why you decided it (optional, for you).
